# opnsense_haproxy_user (Resource)

HAProxy users (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Advanced ▸ Users**, plugin `os-haproxy`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to identify this user.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Both encrypted and unencrypted passwords can be used. Most systems support MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512, and, of course, the classic DES-based method of encrypting passwords.NOTE: Avoid using unencrypted passwords that start with a $-sign, because this indicates an encrypted password and will make it impossible to authenticate.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for this user. Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this user. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the user.
